All ten retained M declarations were actually successfully probed against the pinned runtime, and their source definitions/context and full telescopes were compared with their general NL statements; M009 supplies freeness and M010 explicitly supplies the strong rank premises. The unsuccessful attempt to register the data construction ZMod.instField was not retained as an M. Humphreys' exercise is provenance of the fully supplied target, not an imported unproved E. No external theorem or deferred primary assumption was selected. R001–R005 follow exactly problem.md's five proof phases; all needed calculations, zero cases, rank argument, tensor identifications and final invariant-subspace argument are retained. No material supplied passage was omitted as optional. Every non-H proposition lies in P's AND closure and each N/P has exactly its displayed producer. This is same-author mathematical inspection, not independent Audit A or automatic certification.
